surface_reconstruction: Cell averages are temperature increments relative to 20 C. Interior face = min((c_left+c_right)/2,2*min(c_left,c_right)); exterior faces equal saved massless-boundary values. In a cell with mean c and endpoint values a,b, use an exact affine segment when c=(a+b)/2 within roundoff. Otherwise symmetric shoulder fraction r=min(1/4,c/(a+b)) and plateau p=(c-r*(a+b)/2)/(1-r); piecewise-linear ramps flank a constant plateau. This positive construction conserves each cell mean but is a modelling choice, not a heat-equation spatial interpolant proved accurate. A zero-mean cell with a positive face is incompatible and rejected, including t=0 for the stepped discrete boundary. No clipping or modified source heat.
projection: Positive exponential tilt of sampled concrete increments: T_i=n*m0*exp(log(raw_i)+beta*eta_i)/sum(exp(log(raw)+beta*eta)). Zeros remain zero. Solve beta by bracketed scalar bisection for weighted centroid target=12*M1*I_discrete/m0. Reject targets outside the support of strictly positive sampled fibers. Preserve the inherited mean and equivalent gradient convention, not exact absolute M1; record the absolute first-moment quadrature discrepancy. Steel layers sample the continuous profile without correction. No change of E, alpha, strengths or damage histories.
startup_policy: Do not silently overwrite the algebraic boundary temperature at t=0 or modify the initial cell enthalpy. Record surface reconstruction incompatibility at t=0 separately from an independent all-cold mechanical reference. Qualification covers saved positive-time knots and stated coupons only; no panel history crosses this unresolved startup interface.
scope: Bounded reconstruction/projection and free/restrained section coupons only. No new panel history, no new guard time, no hot fracture, no fire, no global collapse claim. Report infeasible cases rather than requiring them to pass. Finite fiber support cannot generally represent arbitrarily thin heated layers.
sources: Saved V11M numerical fields and protected V11H/I/L/F controls. Reconstruction and projection are explicitly proposed numerical hypotheses, with algebraic reference tests; no new empirical parameter or primary fire datum.
